name: cora
description: Co-citation network of scientific publications. Nodes correspond to publications. Each article is a centroid and forms a hyperedge that connects the article with all publications that cite it or are cited by it.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.features: (LIST[INT]) Indices of words present in the publication (bag-of-words representation; e.g., [118, 125, 176]).
nodes_metadata.label: (INT) Publication topic category (0-6 for 7 categories; e.g., 3).

edges_metadata.label: (LIST[STRING]) Author name or names associated with the publication hyperedge (e.g., [V Gupta]).
edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Stored weight of the publication hyperedge (e.g., 1).
